description: This is a Perl module file defining the Git::I18N package, which provides an interface to gettext localization for Git in Perl. It includes functions for internationalization, conditional loading of the Locale::Messages library, and fallbacks if the library is unavailable.

classes.name: Git::I18N
classes.description: Perl package providing internationalization support for Git via gettext, with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: __bootstrap_locale_messages
methods.description: Initializes locale messages, sets local environment variables, and loads the Locale::Messages module, providing fallbacks if unavailable.

methods.name: N__
methods.description: A no-operation function used for extractors like xgettext to mark strings for translation without translating at runtime.
